title: An etale algebra stays etale modulo an ideal of the base
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings with $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal. Then $\operatorname{Spec}(B/IB)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$, induced by the ring map $A/I\to B/IB$, is etale. (Indeed $B/IB\cong(A/I)\otimes_AB$ as $A/I$-algebras.)
